newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 3.23 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 3.23 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of National Treasury, raised 3.23 billion reais during an auction Friday of Treasury letters, dealers said.
The series of 181-day National Treasury Letters, known as LTNs, is due in March 15 1997, and was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.598 percent a month.
The result of the auction was in line with market expectations and did not indicate any change in the current monetary policy, they added.
